task_id_policy: Single-task queries use query. Q5 target searches use spatial:lighthouse, spatial:wreck, spatial:AnchorageArea, spatial:RestrictedArea; comparison uses comparison; explicit Wreck attribute explanation uses document:Wreck. Optional lighthouse fallback uses document:lighthouse. Public task_mapping per row defines role independent of model-specific subtask names.
prediction_policy: Prediction annotation must be independent of GOLD contents. Canonical task vocabulary and extraction rules must be fixed before scoring. Do not fill missing prediction atoms from GOLD.
accepted_values_policy: Canonical JSON values; distance_m is integer metres. Prediction extraction must apply the fixed lossless canonicalization rules before exact scoring; the scorer itself performs no inference. No unvalidated feature aliases.
human_review_status: New atom representation and canonicalization are AI annotations, not a newly attested human review; existing approval covers parent GOLD only.

rules: finite exact whole metres: 5000 and 5000.0 become integer 5000
explicit km multiplied by 1000; only exact integral metre result admitted
only explicit same CRS identifier conversion; never infer missing CRS or transform geometry

limits: direction/reference arguments of spatial relations are preserved
Q5_02 distance_metric distinguishes polygon-area minimum geodesic distance from boundary-line distance
no model output used to choose canonical forms
